Target apologizes for offensive Halloween costume

Retailer Target issued an apology for a children's Halloween costume that drew criticism for resembling blackface. The costume, described as having "minstrel show features," was compared to blackface by some consumers. Target stated it was "deeply sorry" and that the costume was removed from stores and its website. The company acknowledged the costume was "offensive" and a "stumble at a key moment" for the brand.
